name: Alsafi
description: A naked-eye star 5.8 parsecs away, 78% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 185144: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.254 +/- 0.012 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 0.776 +/- 0.008

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 185144: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5255 +/- 31

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 185144: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 173.77 +/- 0.18 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 6 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 78% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.254 milliarcseconds, which gives 0.776 solar radii and 5,255 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 185144: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
